metadata.remarks:
Identity Device Binding defines the capability to associate identities with specific devices or execution contexts and to continuously validate that association. Device binding reduces the risk of credential replay, remote misuse, and unauthorized access from untrusted environments.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for roles and responsibilities, SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance activities related to identity-device association and context validation. Controls are intentionally scoped to specific binding sub-capabilities.

components.title: Device Association
components.description: Association of identities with known, managed, or registered devices.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Associate identities with organizationally defined devices.
Ensure device-bound identities are managed as part of account management.

components.title: Trust Binding
components.description: Cryptographic and logical binding of identity credentials to a specific device or execution context.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Bind authenticators to specific devices and protect against extraction or reuse.
Use cryptographic mechanisms to enforce trust binding.

components.title: Context Validation
components.description: Continuous validation of device posture, integrity, and execution context during identity usage.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitor device posture and context relevant to identity trust.
Adjust assurance or access based on continuing context validation.
